verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud documents AI-powered capabilities named "Grafana Assistant" and "Investigations", and its Knowledge Graph generates insights about errors, anomalies and failures. This points to a first-party AI investigation feature, but nothing describes the AI analysing a specific alert or error and proposing a probable root cause. missing for 10: documentation of how Investigations analyses an alert or error, evidence of root-cause hypotheses being proposed, alert-to-AI investigation workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Includes AI-powered capabilities for engineering teams, including Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Agent Observability, and more.
generating insights about issues, and connecting metrics, logs, and traces in a unified workflow—no complex queries required.
